set -e
API_URL="https://api.linear.app/graphql"
AUTH_HEADER='Authorization: Bearer INSERT_TOKEN_HERE'
CONTENT_HEADER='Content-Type: application/json'

# 1) Find Engineering team id
read -r TEAM_ID <<< $(curl -s -X POST $API_URL -H "$CONTENT_HEADER" -H "$AUTH_HEADER" -d '{"query":"query TeamsQuery{ teams { nodes { id name } } }"}' | jq -r '.data.teams.nodes[] | select(.name=="Engineering") | .id' | head -n1)

if [ -z "$TEAM_ID" ] || [ "$TEAM_ID" == "null" ]; then
  echo "No team named 'Engineering' found. Listing teams:"
  curl -s -X POST $API_URL -H "$CONTENT_HEADER" -H "$AUTH_HEADER" -d '{"query":"query TeamsQuery{ teams { nodes { id name } } }"}' | jq -r '.data.teams.nodes[] | "- \(.name) (id: \(.id))"'
  exit 0
fi

echo "Found Engineering team id: $TEAM_ID"

# 2) Fetch issues for that team
read -r ISSUES_JSON <<< $(curl -s -X POST $API_URL -H "$CONTENT_HEADER" -H "$AUTH_HEADER" -d "{\"query\":\"query TeamIssues($teamId: ID!){ issues(filter: {team: {id: {eq: $teamId}}}, first: 100) { nodes { id title description url } } }\", \"variables\": {\"teamId\": \"$TEAM_ID\"}}")

# 3) Find issue whose description mentions intermittent and login (case-insensitive)
CANDIDATES=$(echo "$ISSUES_JSON" | jq -r '.data.issues.nodes[] | select((.description // "") | test("intermittent"; "i") and ((.description // "") | test("login"; "i"))) | {id: .id, title: .title, url: .url, desc: .description} | @base64')

if [ -z "$CANDIDATES" ]; then
  # fallback: search in title
  CANDIDATES=$(echo "$ISSUES_JSON" | jq -r '.data.issues.nodes[] | select((.title // "") | test("intermittent"; "i") and ((.title // "") | test("login"; "i"))) | {id: .id, title: .title, url: .url, desc: .description} | @base64')
fi

if [ -z "$CANDIDATES" ]; then
  echo "No issue found whose description or title mentions both 'intermittent' and 'login'."
  echo "Here are the first 20 issues for review:"
  echo "$ISSUES_JSON" | jq -r '.data.issues.nodes[:20][] | "- \(.title) (id: \(.id)) url: \(.url)"'
  exit 0
fi

# Count candidates
COUNT=$(echo "$CANDIDATES" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
if [ "$COUNT" -gt 1 ]; then
  echo "Multiple candidate issues found; please confirm which to rename:"
  echo "$CANDIDATES" | while read -r line; do
    echo "$line" | base64 --decode | jq -r '"- \(.title) (id: \(.id)) url: \(.url)"'
  done
  exit 0
fi

# Single candidate
CANDIDATE_JSON=$(echo "$CANDIDATES" | base64 --decode)
ISSUE_ID=$(echo "$CANDIDATE_JSON" | jq -r '.id')
ISSUE_TITLE=$(echo "$CANDIDATE_JSON" | jq -r '.title')
ISSUE_URL=$(echo "$CANDIDATE_JSON" | jq -r '.url')

echo "Selected issue: $ISSUE_TITLE (id: $ISSUE_ID) url: $ISSUE_URL"

# 4) Rename the issue
NEW_TITLE="Fix login bug - follow up"
MUTATION_PAYLOAD=$(jq -n --arg id "$ISSUE_ID" --arg title "$NEW_TITLE" '{query: "mutation UpdateIssue($id: ID!, $input: IssueUpdateInput!) { issueUpdate(id: $id, input: $input) { success issue { id title url } } }", variables: {id: $id, input: {title: $title}}}')

RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST $API_URL -H "$CONTENT_HEADER" -H "$AUTH_HEADER" -d "$MUTATION_PAYLOAD")

SUCCESS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.data.issueUpdate.success')
if [ "$SUCCESS" != "true" ]; then
  echo "Failed to update issue:" >&2
  echo "$RESPONSE" | jq
  exit 1
fi
UPDATED_TITLE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.data.issueUpdate.issue.title')
UPDATED_URL=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.data.issueUpdate.issue.url')

echo "Renamed issue: '$ISSUE_TITLE' -> '$UPDATED_TITLE'"
echo "URL: $UPDATED_URL"

query($search: String!) {
  issues(search: $search, first: 20) {
    nodes {

      title

      team { id key name }
    }
  }

  echo "Empty response searching for issue."

fi

# try jq to parse
if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  issue_id=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.data.issues.nodes[] | select(.identifier=="'$ISSUE_IDENTIFIER'") | .id' | head -n1)
  team_id=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.data.issues.nodes[] | select(.identifier=="'$ISSUE_IDENTIFIER'") | .team.id' | head -n1)
  issue_title=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.data.issues.nodes[] | select(.identifier=="'$ISSUE_IDENTIFIER'") | .title' | head -n1)
else
  # fallback crude parsing
  issue_id=$(echo "$resp" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | head -n1 | sed 's/"id":"\([^"]*\)"/\1/')
  team_id=$(echo "$resp" | grep -o '"team":{[^}]*}' | head -n1 | sed -n 's/.*"id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
  issue_title="(unknown)"
fi

if [ -z "$issue_id" ] || [ "$issue_id" = "null" ]; then
  echo "Issue $ISSUE_IDENTIFIER not found. Response:"

  exit 1
fi

echo "Found issue $ISSUE_IDENTIFIER: id=$issue_id, title=$issue_title, team_id=$team_id"

# Fetch states for team

query($teamId: ID!) {
  states(teamId: $teamId) {
    nodes { id name }
  }
}
GRAPHQL
)

else
  state_id=$(echo "$resp2" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | sed -n '1p')

if [ -z "$state_id" ] || [ "$state_id" = "null" ]; then
  echo "State named '$TARGET_STATE_NAME' not found for team (id=$team_id). Available states:\n$states_list"

  echo "$resp3"
  exit 0
else

  exit 1
fi

# Helper: get or create label by name
get_or_create_label() {
  local LABEL_NAME="$1"
  # try to find existing label
  read -r LABEL_QUERY <<GRAPHQL
{"query":"query ($name: String!) { labels(filter: {name: {eq: $name}}) { nodes { id name } } }","variables":{"name":"\"$LABEL_NAME\""}}
GRAPHQL
  # Note: Above constructs string including quotes around the variable for the GraphQL server; simpler to query all labels and filter locally if needed

  # Simpler: list labels and grep by name
  read -r LABELS_ALL <<GRAPHQL
{"query":"query { labels { nodes { id name } } }"}
GRAPHQL
  LABELS_RESP=$(curl -s -X POST -H "$CONTENT_HEADER" -H "$AUTH_HEADER" -d "$LABELS_ALL" "$API")
  LABEL_ID=$(echo "$LABELS_RESP" | jq -r --arg name "$LABEL_NAME" '.data.labels.nodes[] | select(.name == $name) | .id' | head -n1 || true)

  if [ -n "$LABEL_ID" ]; then
    echo "$LABEL_ID"

  # create label if not found

GRAPHQL
  CREATE_RESP=$(curl -s -X POST -H "$CONTENT_HEADER" -H "$AUTH_HEADER" -d "$CREATE_LABEL" "$API")
  LABEL_ID=$(echo "$CREATE_RESP" | jq -r '.data.labelCreate.label.id // empty')
  if [ -z "$LABEL_ID" ]; then
    echo "Error creating label '$LABEL_NAME'. Response:"
    echo "$CREATE_RESP"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "$LABEL_ID"
}

UX_LABEL_ID=$(get_or_create_label "UX")

- Add retries and improved error handling around the eval runner boundaries.
- Add detailed logging and metrics for request failures and latency.
- Add unit/integration tests to cover error cases and regressions.

TEAM_KEY=$(jq -r ".data.issues.nodes[] | select(.id==\"$PARENT_ID\") | .team.key" /tmp/find_issue_resp.json)

query {
  users(first: 50) {
    nodes { id name email }
  }

GRAPHQL

SARAH_ID=$(jq -r '.data.users.nodes[] | select(.name=="Sarah") | .id' /tmp/users_resp.json || true)
JOHN_ID=$(jq -r '.data.users.nodes[] | select(.name=="John") | .id' /tmp/users_resp.json || true)

if [ -z "$SARAH_ID" ]; then

fi
if [ -z "$JOHN_ID" ]; then

fi

echo "Sarah id=$SARAH_ID John id=$JOHN_ID"

mutation CreateIssue($input: IssueCreateInput!) {

  local title="$1"; local assigneeId="$2"; local desc="$3"
  input=$(jq -nc --arg teamId "$TEAM_ID" --arg parentId "$PARENT_ID" --arg title "$title" --arg desc "$desc" --arg assigneeId "$assigneeId" '{teamId:$teamId,parentId:$parentId,title:$title,description:$desc,assigneeId:$assigneeId}')

}

RESP2=$(create_issue "Backend API" "$JOHN_ID" "Backend API for SSO (subtask).")

echo "$RESP1" | jq . > /tmp/create1.json
echo "$RESP2" | jq . > /tmp/create2.json

ERR1=$(jq '.errors? // empty' /tmp/create1.json)
ERR2=$(jq '.errors? // empty' /tmp/create2.json)

if [ -n "$ERR1" ] || [ -n "$ERR2" ]; then

if [ -z "$URL2" ]; then URL2="https://linear.app/$TEAM_KEY/issue/$IDENT2"; fi
